verdict.rationale: Google's own pages say Gemini in Gmail drafts and polishes emails and that suggested replies let you reply in one click "in your voice." The Gemini help page adds that drafts can be created or refined for tone and clarity, which covers the core story. The evidence is mostly marketing-level, though. missing for 10: documentation of how voice/tone personalization works (e.g. learning from past sent mail), detail on the review-before-send flow for full AI-drafted replies, independent or hands-on corroboration that output isn't generic.
